main.description: A share grant — gives a specific DID access to a specific document's content encryption key. Created by the document owner when sharing a file ad-hoc (outside of a keyring). The recipient discovers this via their indexer or a notification mechanism. To revoke: delete this record and optionally re-encrypt the document with a new key.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the app.opake.* namespace. Clients should reject records with a version they do not understand.

document.description: AT URI of the app.opake.document record being shared.

wrappedKey.description: The document's content encryption key, wrapped to the recipient's DID public key.

encryptedMetadata.description: Encrypted grant metadata (permissions, note). Encrypted with the document's content key so both grantor and recipient can read it.
